phase2.primary: paired effect estimation of mean held-out episodic return; no forced winner/total ranking
phase2.primary_inference: six paired t contrasts, two-sided, Holm family alpha .05
phase2.model: condition factor plus seed blocks, seed-clustered covariance
phase2.selected_policy: historical training best (GA FULL, upstream Open_ES best_solution, archive best for QD)
phase2.replication_rationale: 20 independent blocks: ordinary 95% mean CI half-width about .47 SD; not a guarantee of pairwise power; ties/inconclusive permitted
phase2.front: descriptive sample-mean return vs training-cost frontier with uncertainty; not an evolved multiobjective front

phase3.primary: quantified composability, no topology superiority requirement
phase3.fronts: separate held-out return vs active stored connections per run; no across-seed pooled Pareto claim
phase3.replication_rationale: 20 independent runs per configuration for descriptive uncertainty, not dominance of one topology

resources.full_campaign_budget_approval: Study sizes approved; launcher transparently proposes at most 8h per phase (24h across three serial allocations); manual submission accepts those ceilings, not a completion forecast.

pilot_exclusion: seeds1000..1002 and all smoke/diagnostic runs excluded; no response-driven margin or schedule tuning
scope: Hopper wrapper, H200, P32/G20 ranking; not standard-environment universal leaderboard
